identity.label: MUX-NOVA (Bonsai Dojo)
identity.description: Auxiliary Ollama host on the nim-substation-bonsai workstation, reachable over Tailscale. Owned hardware sitting idle most of the day - the low-cost dispatch target for text-only work. No tool harness: it generates, it does not act.

channels.label: Qwen3 Coder 30B
channels.notes: 30.5B MoE, Q4_K_M. Measured ~64 tok/s eval warm; first call after idle pays a model-load penalty of roughly 10s. max_concurrent is 1 deliberately - one workstation GPU is not a fleet, and parallel requests queue behind each other anyway.
